description: The headless radio group core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createRadioGroup is the state machine behind SvRadioGroup: single selection, a roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation and the ARIA radiogroup, exposed as groupProps and radioProps. The same core drives the styled component and a custom segmented control with a disabled option, both bound to one value.

faq.question: How does the roving tabindex work?
faq.answer: radioProps(i) gives tabindex 0 to the selected radio and -1 to the rest, so Tab enters the group once and arrow keys move selection and focus together.

faq.question: How are disabled options skipped?
faq.answer: The core excludes them from arrow navigation and radioProps marks them aria-disabled; the custom segmented control greys the segment.

faq.question: Does selection wrap?
faq.answer: Yes. Pressing Down or Right on the last option moves to the first and Up or Left on the first moves to the last, as native radios do.
